# Stormwater Atlas

> Numeric stormwater design requirements read from U.S. federal, state, county and city manuals, each with the quoted sentence and PDF page it came from, plus a draft national model manual built on that evidence. Open data, no API key.

Website: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/
Requirements (one page per design value, every manual's value and quote): https://www.stormwateratlas.com/requirements/
One requirement: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/requirements/{criterionKey}/
Jurisdictions: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/jurisdictions/
One jurisdiction: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/{slug}/
Model manual (draft): https://www.stormwateratlas.com/manual/
Model manual evidence: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/manual/evidence/
Compare up to four jurisdictions: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/compare/?m={slug},{slug}
About and methods: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/about/

## Machine-readable data

- Every numeric value with qualifier, basis, quote, page and check (CSV): https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/values.csv
- Data dictionary: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/dictionary.json
- Dataset version and citation: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/dataset.json
- Index of records: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/manuals.json
- One record: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/manuals/{slug}.json
- Full dump: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/atlas.json
- Field guide: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/schema.json
- Comparison rows: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/compare.json
- Model manual source (Markdown): https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/model-manual.md

## Important

- Check `coverage_basis` before quoting a record. `stand_in` means the page shows another jurisdiction's manual as a placeholder; those values are NOT that place's requirements. `state_manual` / `regional_manual` mean the place adopts a shared manual. National statistics count only `own` and `issuer` records, one value per manual.
- `check` / `citation_check` says whether each quote was found word-for-word in the source PDF. A found quote proves the text exists, not that it was read correctly; `hand_review` marks values a person checked.
- The model manual is a draft for discussion, not adopted regulation.

Always verify against the current official agency document linked in each record.

Data: CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT. https://github.com/scott-jeffers/usa-stormwater
